variants.name: package*.json を写す・EXPOSE を書く

write:
# 窓口のアプリ（server.js）のイメージを作る
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm install
COPY . .
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
